decisions.reason: Because this sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm’s established postpress know-how and remained on its own webpage in 2024, management would expect it can keep learning from and improving the product rather than withdraw it.

Because this folding add-on unit is close to the firm’s core finishing portfolio and already showed a concrete customer application result while still being marketed in 2024, management would likely keep it and exploit related knowledge to refine and sell it further.
